verdict.rationale: Convex documents several programmatic surfaces that cover many dashboard-style tasks. The CLI pushes functions and schema, runs queries, mutations and actions, imports data, streams logs and shows health insights. Public functions are also exposed as HTTP endpoints, and an official MCP server lets agents interact with deployments. Nothing in the evidence claims API/UI parity, though: there is no documented management API for project, team, env-var or deployment administration, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an explicit parity commitment or a documented platform/management API covering all dashboard actions, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration that no UI-only operations remain.
